label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter 'param' flows through HashMap storage and retrieval, then concatenates with TESTFILES_DIR to create fileName passed to FileInputStream. No path traversal prevention (allowlist/blocklist) exists despite decoding. The XSS finding is secondary to the path injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input flows through decode() -> HashMap -> concatenation with TESTFILES_DIR -> new File() creating path traversal risk
